decision_rule.text: Re-decision of module M0 (review loop off) under the TRAIN A own null. Let R be the replicate and B0 the first pass, both against the sealed anchor A on the same 1,080 rows with the same paired whole-speaker bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915). Own-null half-widths h_SLU and h_intent are the CI95 half-widths of (R minus B0) for pooled SLU and intent respectively (same rows, same interval level as the clauses). Clause 1 (SLU): the CI95 lower bound of (B0 minus A) exceeds -h_SLU AND the CI95 lower bound of (R minus A) exceeds -h_SLU. Clause 2 (intent): the same with h_intent. NEUTRAL if both clauses hold on both passes; ADMITTED-as-gain if additionally the CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta exceeds zero on both passes; HARMFUL otherwise. Diagnostics reported beside the rule and never used for it: the (R minus B0) point estimates, saves/harms, per-scenario tables, contacts and GPU hours of R, and the anchor-vs-R comparison. This rule replaces the imported DEV1000 margin for this module only; the first-pass status HARMFUL-by-rule stays on record beside the re-decision, as the KC-E1f v1/v2 pair does.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster/role-graph/prompt/geometry/cap change or silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism. No third pass of this configuration is registered or authorized.

first_pass_numbers_being_re_decided.why_the_rule_could_not_certify: The imported DEV-1000 margins are narrower than the CI95 half-widths this 1,080-row roster yields: intent 1.1745 pp against an imported 0.92, pooled SLU 1.3021 pp against an imported 1.18. A non-inferiority clause whose margin is narrower than the measurement's own noise cannot certify a null module; it can only reject.
